instruction: I need you to disable the global play/pause hotkey in VLC. Please turn off the global hotkey for play/pause functionality.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires disabling VLC's global play/pause hotkey. Evaluator uses existing check_global_key_play_pause metric to verify VLC config has global-key-play-pause set to empty (disabled).
metadata.verification: Verified that check_global_key_play_pause checks VLC config file vlcrc for global-key-play-pause setting. When empty, the metric returns '0' (disabled), otherwise '1' (enabled).
